rule: Word the Cause and the title only as widely as the cases tried, and claim no more than the run checked.

remove.from: Look for a second code path
Claim no more than the run checked

criterion: The title names the Add Filter popup and closing it with Escape, not popups, menus or dialogs in general and not every way of closing it. The cause does not blame the shared popup component for every popup, or, if it names the shared component, it says why the sort menu and closing by a click outside were not affected. A title or cause that claims the fault for any popup, every popup built on the component, or closing in general does not pass.
